    Compatible presilting classes on either side of a given class #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.compatible_of_precompose {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {P Q : TwoTerm R} (hP : P.IsPresilting) (hPQ : Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential))) (hQP : Function.Surjective ⇑(Q.precompose (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential))) (hQ : Function.Surjective ⇑(Q.precompose (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential))) :
    (P.directSum Q).IsPresilting
    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_compatible_add_projective {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (G : FiniteProjective R) :
    ∃ (Q : TwoTerm R), (P.directSum Q).IsPresilting ∧ Q.projectiveClass = Module.finrank k (P.source ⟶ ↑G) • P.projectiveClass + ProjectiveClass.of G

    A projective class can be added to a nonnegative multiple of a presilting class while retaining compatibility with the original complex.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_compatible_cokernel_add_projective {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (hm : ∀ (a : P.source ⟶ P.source), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a P.differential = P.differential → CategoryTheory.IsIso a) (G : FiniteProjective R) :
    ∃ (Q : TwoTerm R), (P.directSum Q).IsPresilting ∧ moduleProjectiveClass k (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential) = Module.finrank k (P.source ⟶ ↑G) • P.projectiveClass + ProjectiveClass.of G

    For a minimal presentation the positive completion has the g-vector of its cokernel. There is no contribution from a shifted projective summand.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_compatible_sub_projective {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (G : FiniteProjective R) :
    ∃ (Q : TwoTerm R), (P.directSum Q).IsPresilting ∧ Q.projectiveClass = Module.finrank k (↑G ⟶ P.target) • P.projectiveClass - ProjectiveClass.of G

    The opposite completion uses the universal map from the projective into copies of the target of the given differential.
